capsuleTopic.title: Noah
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Favor · flood · household · covenant · memory
capsuleTopic.orientation: Follow Noah from his naming and the violent world around him through warning, ship-building, flood preservation, dry ground, offering, covenant, household fracture, death, and later canonical memory. Keep Noah distinct from the Flood event and the Covenant concept.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Notice what Noah is called, told, does, waits for, receives, says, and becomes when later writers return to his story.

payload.description: Genealogy, prophecy, wisdom, prayer, and analogy remember Noah for ancestry, righteousness, preservation, covenant, and endurance.
